commonDenialReasons.reason: No evidence of acoustic trauma in service
commonDenialReasons.counterStrategy: Obtain buddy statements, document MOS noise exposure

commonDenialReasons.reason: No nexus between current tinnitus and service
commonDenialReasons.counterStrategy: Obtain IMO addressing delayed onset, in-service noise exposure
Challenge examiner rationale, note Colvin if VA added own conclusions

military_noise_exposure.description: Documented noise exposure during military service

onset_timing.description: When symptoms began relative to service
onset_timing.unfavorable: Many years after service with intervening noise exposure

successPatterns.pattern: Combat MOS with buddy statement and IMO
successPatterns.description: Veterans with combat or high-noise MOS who obtain supporting statements
When hearing loss is already SC, tinnitus often follows as secondary

failurePatterns.pattern: Long gap with post-service noise exposure
failurePatterns.description: Decades between service and diagnosis with civilian noise jobs
failurePatterns.mitigation: Obtain IMO addressing why military exposure is more likely cause

commonFactors: Competent lay testimony of onset and continuity
